label: consistent

said.text: Our first-in-the-nation RAISE Act would put commonsense guardrails around this technology so it can actually help people, not just line the pockets of a chosen few. … states like New York must fight back to create a future that works for everyone.

did.text: Voted Yes on S6954-B, the Stop Deepfakes Act, requiring providers of synthetic-content systems to include provenance data on AI-generated content. Passed Assembly 141–0.

whyNote: The statement, issued jointly with Sen. Gounardes in response to a proposed federal ban on state AI regulation, cites a different bill (the RAISE Act) and argues for state-level AI safeguards; the vote passed a separate state AI measure whose Assembly companion (A6540) Bores sponsors. The label reflects alignment between the stated position and this vote. The quote is excerpted; the full statement is at the source.
